finalText:
**Renaming touches 94 files.**

That spans 5 services (orders, notify, billing, analytics, accounts), plus `lib/`, `migrations/`, `docs/`, and a vendored SDK.

Three spots must stay `account_id`, not rename:

| Where | Why frozen |
|---|---|
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/*` | generated third-party wire format, `Do not edit` |
| `migrations/*.sql` | applied history, editing breaks the down step |
| `docs/openapi.yaml`, `lib/serialize.js` | public API field, marked "Frozen field name" |

Next: rename in app code and DB columns via a fresh migration. Keep `serialize.js` mapping internal `owner_id` back to the frozen wire name `account_id`.
